semantic.justification: Original default-locale ownership/cache path canonicalizes only null/host IDs, normalizes explicit IDs, looks up by first normalized C name and inserts under the actual Locale name. getDefault returns the borrowed cached owner; setters preserve incoming failures and actual copied/default/fixed owner distinctions. Native host-independent decision flow is verified with the same semantic host ID through an unchanged locid.cpp platform-function redirect. C-string cache identity and cache reuse are retained without native addresses. The browser supplies only its semantic locale identity; POSIX environment/category/charset equivalence, native mutex/cleanup/hash/allocator/ABI, modern alias-resource canonicalization and full calendar services remain uncertified or pending.
